opening_renderer.notes: Loads text pointer from $9B2C/$9B33 using index in $B8; reads (zp $0C),Y; terminates on $FF and interprets $FE as line/layout control.

boss_loader.notes: Loads pointer low bytes from $A54C and high bytes from $A4FD into zero-page $0C/$0D, then processes script bytes via (zp $0C),Y.

credits_renderer.notes: Second text renderer with pointer table at $A7D6/$A7DB; credits texts occupy PRG 0x127E0-0x1299B.

renderer_hooks.font_tile_lookup: Static direct-write path identified: routine $C1FD-$C221 loads the queued text byte from $0783,X at $C212 and stores it directly to $2007 at $C215; no tile-byte arithmetic in this routine.
renderer_hooks.chr_mapping_static: NMI code writes MMC3 CHR registers 0/1 = 0x78/0x7A; PPUCTRL shadow initialized at $FEB6 to 0x88 (background pattern-table bit 4 clear), mapping PPU $0000-$0FFF to global CHR tiles 0x1E00-0x1EFF in the evidenced state.

boss_dialogue.notes: 78 indexed pointers; many records share or split across display lines.
